games.name: Deep Rock Galactic: Survivor
games.summary:
DEEP ROCK GALACTIC: SURVIVOR is a single player survivor-like auto-shooter. Wield the full arsenal of Deep Rock Galactic, take on hordes of lethal aliens, mine riches, and unlock powerful upgrades. It's one dwarf against all of Planet Hoxxes!

Kill bugs, upgrade your gear, and delve ever deeper into the lethal caves of Hoxxes. Collect and assemble a devastating array of guns, unleash hell upon wave after wave of alien monsters in fast and frenetic combat, and tunnel your way to collect precious riches from deep within the cave walls. Each mission is unique, using procedural cave generation and enemy waves, just as you've come to know from Deep Rock Galactic.

games.name: HORSE CLUB Ride West
games.summary: The HORSE CLUB is visiting the Wild River Ranch! Travel with your friends Hannah, Sofia, Sarah, and Lisa to the Wild West. Explore the vast landscape, help old and new friends, experience exciting adventures on horseback, and win the crown at the Western riding tournament!

games.name: My Lovey-Dovey Demon
games.summary: A cute love story between a young man and an affectionate, adoring, utterly insatiable demon girl set in the Japanese countryside.

games.name: PARCEL INSPECTION SIMULATOR
games.summary:
Inspect every parcel and keep the deliveries moving.

Welcome to Parcel Inspection Simulator, where every package tells a story — and every detail matters. Step into the role of an inspector responsible for keeping the flow of parcels moving smoothly.

From small envelopes to large shipments, dozens of packages pass through your hands each day. Check documents, inspect deliveries, and make sure everything reaches the right destination. Stay sharp, work efficiently, and turn a small inspection point into a thriving logistics operation.

Key Features:
• Receive and Sort Parcels – Manage the full parcel workflow: accept shipments, sort them correctly, and prepare them for the next stage of processing.
• Inspect Documents Carefully – Verify sender and recipient information, identify incorrect data, and prevent costly mistakes.
• Multiple Inspection Methods – Use different tools and checking methods to ensure every parcel meets the correct requirements.
• Upgrade Your Workspace – Expand your inspection area, upgrade equipment, and improve your parcel processing system.
• Increasing Workload – Handle more packages and more complex tasks as operations grow busier and more demanding.
• Build an Efficient Operation – Start with a small inspection point and develop it into a well-organized parcel management system.

games.name: Rhythm Roll
games.summary: Roll through a world of rhythm and light in Rhythm Roll! Control a fast-moving ball through stunning levels, each with its own unique visual style and musical genre. Dodge obstacles, stay on the beat, and test your reflexes. Simple to play, but can you master the speed?

games.name: Sesame Street: Friends & Fun
games.summary:
Welcome to Sesame Street! A place to play, laugh and grow.

From the moment you arrive, there’s so much to do. Join Elmo, Tango and the rest of your Sesame Street friends around the neighborhood!

Walk around with Grover, plant a magical giant beanstalk in Abby’s Garden, find useful tools and rubber ducks in the Community Garden with Bert & Ernie, and work on your number and puzzle skills in Count von Count’s Mansion. Or cook, mix and laugh along with Cookie Monster in his Foodie Truck! Some quests may take a few tries, but you’ll work together to find a way to make the streets a brighter and happier place for everyone.

Make yourself at home! Decorate your house, unlock new mini-games, access exciting new areas of the Street, or throw and unforgettable block party. Spend time with Tango, your cheerful and furry helper or enjoy the whole adventure together with family and friends in local co-op play.

games.name: Sugar Rush Rescue
games.summary:
A tasty, retro co-op adventure.

When best friends Colby and Jack find a forest of candy, they're ready to munch! But while the boys selfishly sample the sweets, Colby's little sister is abducted by a monstrous owl! Now they must navigate a world of confections as they learn to pay attention to what matters most.

Featuring a wide range of obstacles, enemies, and levels to explore, Sugar Rush Rescue is a tasty, retro co-op adventure.

games.name: Wrap House Simulator
games.summary: Welcome to Wrap House Simulator! Run your own wrap shop, chop, grill, and serve in this cooking adventure. Customize your shop, master the grill, and survive the rush solo or co-op with up to 4 players. Keep up with orders, satisfy customers, and build your dream restaurant!

games.name: Colorbound
games.summary:
Bring the world around you to life with the power of color in Colorbound, a vibrant palette-platformer. 

Join Anku on a heartfelt journey to reunite his late grandfather’s band by using color to shape the world around you. As you journey, you’ll solve puzzles, uncover secrets, and help a family of musicians come together one last time.

games.name: Just Dance: Decades of Hits
games.summary:
IMMERSIVE EXPERIENCE SPANNING 6 DECADES
Each decade features its own visual identity and carefully curated tracklist, letting you jump between musical eras or build the ultimate throwback-to-modern playlist in one seamless experience. Discover it all through the all-new Adventure Mode, a cheerful story-driven journey that has you dancing your way through the decades.

DANCE TO SONGS EVERYONE KNOWS
Celebrate iconic intergenerational hits brought to life with unique choreography, including fan-favorites like:

- "NUEVAYoL" by Bad Bunny
- "Manchild" by Sabrina Carpenter
- "Danza Kuduro" by Lucenzo & Don Omar
- "Turn Down for What" by DJ Snake & Lil Jon
- "Feel Good Inc." by Gorillaz
- "Bye Bye Bye" by *NSYNC
- "Wannabe" by Spice Girls
- "No Scrubs" by TLC
- "It's Tricky" by Run DMC
- "Uptown Girl" by Billy Joel
- "Mamma Mia" by ABBA

games.name: SpongeBob SquarePants: Titans of the Tide
games.summary: Prepare to be scared! A clash between the Flying Dutchman and King Neptune has unleashed ghostly mayhem all over Bikini Bottom. Switch seamlessly between SpongeBob and Patrick, combine their unique skills and save Bikini Bottom from total ghostification!

games.name: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse
games.summary:
1499. Paris is engulfed as monstrous creatures suddenly emerge from the shadows.

Armed with the legendary holy whip, the Vampire Killer, Trevor Belmont’s successor ventures into the burning streets and the looming castle to hunt down the beasts.

Will she succeed in saving Paris from devastation...?

Set 23 years after Castlevania Dracula's Curse - follow a young Belmont's journey in an all new 2D Action-Exploration title from KONAMI, Evil Empire and Motion Twin.

games.name: SHOCKWAVE TRIGGERS
games.summary:
Shockwave Triggers is a vertical scrolling shoot’em up where you’ll choose between 2 pilots – the fast and versatile Amira, whose crystal-sensitive sister has been kidnapped, and the slower but more powerful Turbo B, a mechanic determined to take down the supreme leader of the WW army!

Enjoy anime-style cutscenes and a pumping soundtrack as you blast through 6 unique stages of bullet hell mayhem. Collect crystals from destroyed enemies, initiate shockwaves to cancel incoming projectiles into gems, deploy super attacks and upgrade your ship with character-specific armaments!

Use the shop system to earn new features or buy extra credits, choose from multiple difficulties to suit your playstyle, fill your gallery with unlockable art and use the jukebox feature to enjoy the game’s original soundtrack. Team up for local co-op play, dare to challenge Boss Rush mode and test your skills against online leaderboards!

games.name: Bluey's Happy Snaps
games.summary:
Explore, have fun and capture your favorite moments with Bluey and Bingo in this photo-powered game. Look out for familiar spots from the show, create your own scrapbook and turn in-game memories into playful moments for real life.

Bluey and Bingo have found Dad's old camera (back from when he was cool). Take it with you around the world of Bluey and snap photos of the games they play and wildlife they discover. Each snapshot is saved to Bluey's scrapbook, where players can keep their favorite moments.

Share the adventure side-by-side! A second player can join in to explore and strike a pose while the main player leads the adventure behind the camera. You can even play with toys together along the way!

games.name: Cubic Cosmos
games.summary: Cubic Cosmos is a thrilling fast-paced roguelike card game. You have been trapped in a deadly game. One wrong move could see you reduced to a plaything of the goddess. Can you free yourself from the endless cycle and escape your fate?

games.name: Disney/Pixar Toy Story 3 Complete Edition
games.summary:
Reopen the toy chest and saddle up as Woody, Buzz Lightyear, and Jessie in Toy Story 3 Complete Edition, a 3D adventure based on the hit 2010 animated film, Toy Story 3. The updated game features improved graphics and a few new surprises in store. Play through authentic moments from the movie in Story Mode, or drop into the wild west sandbox of Woody’s Roundup in Toy Box Mode.

In Story Mode, swap between Woody, Buzz, and Jessie as you play through iconic scenes from the film, including the train rescue, Operation Playtime, surviving the junkyard, and more. Harness each character's unique abilities, whether you need to swing on Woody’s pull string or use Buzz’s strength to throw the other toys long distances. You can even play in two-player co-op.

Step out of Story Mode and into the sandbox in Toy Box Mode. This fan-favorite, customizable mode drops you into the wild west of Woody’s Roundup. Like Story Mode, you play as Woody, Buzz, or Jessie, but in Toy Box Mode you can play however you want! Characters around town give you quests to complete, so you can earn gold and spend it on personalizing the town your way. Build, decorate and customize the buildings, dress up the townsfolk, and more.

games.name: Harvest Moon: Echoes of Teradea
games.summary:
The mist of the Forest of Echoes now covers the land of Teradea, and outside of Bloomfield Village where you were raised, wild wolves appear at night. There are even rumors of a large guardian wolf that rules them all...but you and your best friend are about to change that!

Throwing caution to the wind, you’ll set out on a mission to tame those wolves and end up unlocking a journey far greater than you imagined. Help the Guardian Spirits to revive and revitalize Teradea! Visit the port village of Tidewind to uncover what’s causing the storms there. Trek to the mining village of Quarrytop to get to the bottom of the mystery of the earthquakes that are happening. Then, stay in the once-thriving town and cultural center of Maplehill to revive its fading light and community.

Between your travels, tend your farm, raise animals, harvest crops, and build a life for yourself. Guided by the Harvest Goddess and aided by the friends you’ll make in each of the villages, you’ll find new ways to grow, explore, and lend a hand wherever it’s needed. 

With the support of those you’ve helped - and those who stand beside you - you may discover a way to lift the veil from the Forest of Echoes and let Teradea flourish once more!

games.name: Tavern Talk: Complete Edition
games.summary:
Discover the cozy fantasy world of Tavern Talk Complete Edition, the first-ever physical Nintendo Switch release of the beloved visual novel adventure.

This Deluxe Edition includes the full base game along with both the Pirate Palooza and Tempest Tantrum DLC on cartridge, delivering the complete Wayfarer’s Inn experience in one definitive package.

games.name: The Jackbox Party Pack 12
games.summary:
The idea wizards at Jackbox Games are following up on the hit Party Pack 11 with brand-new party games!

The Jackbox Party Pack 12 will include 5 different games designed to take your party to new heights. You’ll find new ways to channel your inner comedian, artist, mind reader, debater, and team captain. Like the true multihyphenate you are! Are you sure you didn’t time-travel from the Renaissance era?  

In true Party Pack fashion, no extra controllers are necessary! Use your smartphones, tablets, or computer browsers to join the game and play along. Got a big group? Additional players can jump into audience mode to influence the game in unique ways.

games.name: Toy Story: Retro Roundup! / Toy Story 3: Complete Edition
games.summary:
Get all the toys in the toy chest with this double pack, featuring both Toy Story: Retro Roundup! and Toy Story 3 Complete Edition. Play as classic characters as you navigate familiar worlds and take on challenges inspired by the films. 

Toy Story: Retro Roundup! includes 11 classic games, with both console and handheld versions of four Toy Story games, along with A Bug’s Life. 

Toy Story 3 Complete Edition brings back the fan-favorite 3D adventure for modern consoles!

games.name: Tales of Eternia Remastered
games.summary:
Journey to Eternia, a world split into two isolated realms, Inferia and Celestia.

In the remote Inferian village of Rasheans, Reid Hershel and his childhood friend Farah Oersted meet a mysterious girl named Meredy. During their journey to discover Meredy's origins, the group discovers that a collision called the "Great Fall" threatens both Inferia and Celesita.

Harnessing the power of elemental spirits known as the Greater Craymels, Reid and his companions embark on an epic journey to save the two realms from catastrophe.

games.name: Tenebris Somnia
games.summary:
Tenebris Somnia is a survival horror adventure game in the same vein as classics like Silent Hill or Resident Evil - but adapted to a retro 2D aesthetic from the 8 or 16-bit era.

You will struggle to survive while solving puzzles and fighting horrible creatures. 

Yet the secrets of the game lie within its cinematics...

When you reach certain key points you will see sequences from a completely different point of view, made in live action with real actors and practical effects - created by a professional and award winning film crew from Argentina.

games.name: Frostpunk
games.summary: In a completely frozen world, people develop steam-powered technology to oppose the overwhelming cold. Society in its current form becomes ineffective and it has to change in order to survive.

games.name: Classic Sonic Collection
games.summary:
Decades of classics and endless speed. Spin dash through iconic worlds, celebrate the legacy, and keep going in one epic collection of sonic adventures.

Sonic Mania
Experience classic 2D Sonic action with stunning retro inspired visuals, reimagined fan favorite zones, new bosses, and playable Sonic, tails and knuckles. Race, fly and smash your way through a nostalgic adventure with co op and competition modes.

Sonic Origins
Relive Sonic's most iconic adventures, including Sonic and the hedgehog, Sonic the Hedgehog 2, Sonic 3 and Knuckles, and Sonic CD, fully remastered in high definition. Revisit the games that launched a legend and shaped generations of Sonic fans.

Sonic Superstars
Race through classic sonic platforming reimagined with vibrant 3D visuals, new chaos emerald powers, and an all new adventure. Play as Sonic, Tails, Knuckles or Amy, team up with friends in 4 player co op, and take on Dr. Eggman and his allies across the Northstar Islands.

games.name: I Am Your Beast
games.summary:
I Am Your Beast is a shortform covert revenge thriller FPS about getting hunted across the North American wilderness by the military-industrial complex--and turning the tables.

You are secret agent Alphonse Harding. Retired for six years, you've been asked to complete ‘one last job’, one too many times. Declining your latest mission sets in motion a furious guerilla war between you and the Covert Operations Initiative (COI) that litters the forest with bodies and bullet casings.

Break your opponents. Use their own equipment against them. Duck into your tunnel network before enemy forces zero in on your location. Repeat.

games.name: Modern Sonic Collection
games.summary:
Three adventures and unlimited speed. Blast through alien amusement parks, rally a resistance, and explore uncharted frontiers in three epic Sonic adventures.

Sonic Forces
The evil Dr. Eggman has taken control of the world. Now you must defeat iconic old villains and fight a powerful new enemy to reclaim the world in this epic new adventure.

Sonic Colors Ultimate
Join Sonic on a high speed adventure to free the Wisps from Dr. Eggman's interstellar amusement park. Race through six vibrant worlds, harness powerful Wisp abilities, and overcome dangerous challenges.

Sonic Frontiers
In search of the missing chaos emeralds, Sonic becomes stranded on an ancient island teeming with unusual creatures. Battle hordes of powerful enemies as you explore a breathtaking world of action, adventure, and mystery.

games.name: Hail to the Rainbow
games.summary:
The story of a lonely young man named Ignat, who survives in the dangerous and gloomy world of post-apocalyptic cyberpunk. The few survivors of the tragic military events had to adapt to the new conditions of existence. Ignat, who lost his parents, was able to build his life alone and learned a lot in this new reality.

However, the life of the protagonist, which has already become familiar in a few years, changes dramatically when an unexpected message arrives by e-mail.

"Hail to the Rainbow" is a first-person story-driven adventure game with horror and shooter elements. In the universe of the game, you will face the dangers of a new reality, immerse yourself in the secrets of the surrounding chaos, and also relive the memories and moral torment of the protagonist. 

Explore the environment, explore electronic records and solve technical puzzles, collect items and upgrade your inventory, this will come in handy on your journey.

games.name: Cotton Reboot! High Tension!
games.summary:
The sequel to "Cotton Reboot!" released in 2021 is here! Will the gluttonous witch Nata de Cotton be in action again this time?

Enjoy this even more powerful and refreshing witchy shooter!

games.name: Demons' Night Fever
games.summary:
Based on classic grid-based strategy games, this entirely new SRPG features the Peon Exploitation System - a brutal combat mechanic where you mercilessly sacrifice your own allies.

The more misdeeds you commit, the more vicious your army becomes, and the greater your advantage in battle!

Regain the lost power of the Devil, Giga Super Death, who was transformed into a baby, and crush the false god wearing a mask of justice!

games.name: Final Fantasy Resonance
games.summary: Return to the pixel‑art world of FINAL FANTASY, evolved from its classic roots. Travel with companions bound by fate and call on Visions to aid you in battle to uncover the truth behind a force that threatens to bring everything to ruin.

games.name: Final Kick Football Legends
games.summary: Final Kick Football Legends is a Sports game, developed by Ivanovich Games and published by GS2 Games.

games.name: Gaelco Sports Collection
games.summary:
Get ready for the ultimate 90s arcade rush. This collection brings back 5 legendary, lightning-fast hits developed by the arcade masters at Gaelco. Forget complex simulations; here, it’s all about raw reflexes, immediate fun, and high-speed challenges that defined a generation of cabinet gaming.

Drive at breakneck speeds in the cult-classic isometric racers World Rally Championship and World Rally 2, where every corner requires perfect drifts against a brutal 60-second timer.

Conquer treacherous slopes in Snowboard Championship, execute precise racket strikes in Squash, and dominate the sand with fierce smashes in Touch and Go.

It’s a pure dopamine rush straight from the golden age of arcades.

games.name: Moadra
games.summary: Endure... Evolve... or die. Embrace the unknown and traverse a vast alien world riddled with bizarre creatures, deadly hazards, and grim mysteries. Seek redemption, and confront the terrifying sin buried in the depths of the forgotten planet Protea VI.

games.name: ONE PIECE: Grand Gourmet
games.summary: Hop aboard a delectable management sim in the world of ONE PIECE! Work alongside the Straw Hat Crew to build the greatest floating restaurant of the seas. Collect ingredients, dream up dishes, and decorate to have familiar faces lining up for more!

games.name: Warrior Cats: Clans of the Forest
games.summary: Create your own Warrior Cat and journey through the Lake Territories in an immersive action-adventure inspired by the beloved Warrior Cats book series. Hunt, explore, battle rival Clans, uncover prophecies, and shape your legacy with every choice you make.

games.name: 9 R.I.P. sequel
games.summary:
The previous work, "9 RIP," weaves the story of a bizarre love and the supernatural encounters in the afterlife. In this "9 RIP sequel," you can enjoy the continuation of the story.

The work begins with the two endings from the previous work. The main content, "Heaven Edition," which takes place after "Final Act: Heaven," is a sequel that depicts a new horror.

The sub-content, "God Edition," which takes place after "Final Act: God," is a fan disc that leads to a sweet and happy ending.

Please look forward to the various strange worlds and the fate of the strange characters and the love that is woven once again.

games.name: Dog Man: Bark in Action
games.summary:
Join Dog Man and his Supa Buddies for a supa-new adventure! A comic-book style game packed with action, humor, boss fights, and ability-granting gadgets. Play as 10 different characters from the comics, each with unique powers.

A hero is needed! Dr. Scum has set up Hypno Screens around the city, mind-controlling the innocent townsfolk. Now it’s up to Dog Man - part Dog, part Man- to fight back against Dr. Scum and all his minions. Defeat Dr. Scum, save your friends, and rescue the city!

games.name: Village in the Shade
games.summary:
From the development team behind the Yomawari series, Hono Gurashi no Niwa is a life simulation game set in a nostalgic rural village.

Farm and take care of livestock, enjoy activities like fishing and hunting, and deepen your relationships with the other villagers…

Your nostalgic and heartwarming rural life begins.

games.name: Fallen City Brawl
games.summary:
As a brutal battle for control of Fallen City's criminal underworld rages, four strangers join forces to survive and reclaim the streets! With a ferocious wolf at their sides, these unlikely allies will face impossible odds. Along the way, motivations and past lives will collide, further testing their loyalty as well as their fighting skills. Only by binding together can they reach the final showdown that will decide who lives and who falls.

Inspired by arcade beat 'em ups of the late '80s and early '90s, Fallen City Brawl is a story of ambition and revenge told through intense side-scrolling pixel art action.

games.name: Gennady
games.summary: Gennady is a dynamic roguelike platformer, where you must fight your way through shifting corridors filled with chthonic creatures, and death only makes you stronger. All wrapped in the legendary absurdity and classic animation inspired by the era of Earthworm Jim.

games.name: Croc 2 Kingdom of the Gobbos
games.summary: Croc's back, and this time he's searching for his long-lost parents. Revived by the Dantinis, arch enemy Baron Dante vows revenge. Explore four mainland villages, rescue Gobbos, and battle new Guardians. Race cars and speedboats, ride minecarts, and take to the skies in the remastered 1999 classic.

games.name: Hello Kitty Party Land
games.summary: Join the party at Party Land and team up with beloved Sanrio characters to play together in a variety of exciting mini games. Meet over 145 beloved characters and collect their stickers! Team up with one of 16 playable Sanrio characters and play as your own avatar or your favorite teammate. Jump into 45+ mini games with friends, either offline or online. Try Board Game mode, and keep the fun going with quick mini games while you wait for your turn.  Create a character that’s uniquely yours! Customize everything from hairstyles to outfits, and unlock even more items as you progress through the game.

games.name: Joe & Mac Retro Collection
games.summary:
Developed by Red Art Studios, Red Art Games' internal development studio, the Joe & Mac Retro Collection is a compilation of Joe & Mac: Caveman Ninja, Congo's Caper, and Joe & Mac 2: Lost in the Tropics, the three Joe & Mac titles developed by Data East and released on Super Nintendo between 1991 and 1995. 

In addition to allowing players to rediscover the original games as they were presented back in the 90s, the Joe & Mac Retro Collection also features numerous quality of life improvements!

games.name: Pardon My French Toast
games.summary:
Welcome to the Jam Session Cruise! Lucky you, you just happened to stumble across a ticket for a lovely vacation at sea! At least, until you discover that this boat can barely float!

Pardon My French Toast is a 3D platformer starring a slice of toast who covers himself in sweet spreads to get fun abilities.

Explore dozens of levels and find huge candies to fuel the boat. From fruity cakes to tropical jungles to haunted floating islands (and more!), get bready for some tasty sights!

You're not alone on this cruise; lots of other toasts are along for the ride! Get to know them: they’ve all got a good reason for being there. Maybe you can help them?

games.name: Souls of Bombarika
games.summary: A lone ghost battles deadly Ghost Bosses threatening humanity. Possess objects, solve reality-bending puzzles, and uncover an emotional mother-son story.

games.name: STEINS;GATE RE:BOOT
games.summary:
Scenarios with Improved Readability
Based on the scenario from STEINS;GATE ELITE, the story has been refined to be more evenly paced, with an overall smoother reading experience. Along with new dialogue and narrative text, a brand-new worldline and ending scenario have been added, bringing players a story never before seen. The game features a substantially expanded volume of text, delivering a richer story experience.

Newly Recorded Voices and Sound
All in-game voice lines have been newly recorded in Japanese, while the entire soundtrack has been remade by Composer Tsuyoshi Abo.

Revamped Graphics
All character art, backgrounds, and event still images have been completely redrawn from scratch, resulting in a major visual revamp. Compared to the original Xbox 360 version, the number of event still images has approximately doubled, while the number of background visuals has increased by roughly 20%. The expanded volume of artwork delivers an even more immersive experience.

games.name: The Last Cat in the Universe
games.summary: Gather the remains of a dying space station to build a cozy home for the last cat in the universe. A short, narrative-driven incremental game about finding peace in the face of darkness

games.name: The Transference
games.summary: Jump into an escape room set in a deranged mind and experience a first-person exploration game in a chilling new dimension. Shift between three perspectives and attempt to unravel the mystery hiding in this mind-bending psychological thriller. Project yourself into a riveting narrative experience and become immersed in an unsettling psychological thriller. Piece together a family's mystery as you recover fragmented memories from the corrupted consciousness of each perspective. In this first-person narrative mystery, you must explore the walls of the family's home to interpret events and discover the truth. Playable in VR and non-VR modes.

games.name: The Wolf Among Us Remastered
games.summary:
Step back into Fabletown in The Wolf Among Us Remastered - the definitive edition of Telltale’s acclaimed noir narrative thriller inspired by DC’s award-winning Fables comic series.

Critically acclaimed, The Wolf Among Us became one of the most celebrated story-driven adventures of its generation, praised for its unforgettable characters, sharp writing, and meaningful player choice.

Fully remastered with enhanced visuals and modern presentation, this definitive edition brings Bigby Wolf’s first investigation to life with greater atmosphere, immersion, and detail than ever before - honoring the original experience while introducing Fabletown to a new generation of players.

Investigate brutal murders, interrogate suspects, explore crime scenes, and uncover a conspiracy hiding beneath the streets of Fabletown, where myths and legends live secretly among us.

games.name: The Zibbo Show
games.summary: Free US Music Quiz with the best songs from all decades! Play QUIZSTONE® alone or use your knowledge to defeat your friends or random opponents. There is a game mode for every occasion. QUIZSTONE® lets you play & learn at the same time. There is no time to waste. Test your knowledge with QuizStone®! LANGUAGE: English PLAYERS: 1–4 (single player, multiplayer) AGE RANGE: 7+ SETUP TIME: 1 minute GAME MODES: Duel™, Examination™, Reaction™ & Party™ PLAYING TIME: 5-45 minutes INTERNET:Required RANDOM CHANCE: Low SKILL REQUIRED: Music knowledge DIFFICULTY: High CATEGORIES: 20 NO. QUESTIONS: 600+

games.name: Asylum
games.summary:
ASYLUM is an ambitious and intricate first-person horror adventure casting you into the hallucinatory setting of the Hanwell Mental Institute. Interact with its curious denizens, gather clues, unravel the mystery, and march towards a shocking conclusion.

With influences ranging from Lovecraft to Peter Cushing to Lucio Fulci, ASYLUM has been meticulously crafted with a strong focus on storytelling and atmosphere. Explore countless tenebrous environments, make your way through a towering, lifelike mental hospital, and solve compelling puzzles to find the answers you seek.

games.name: Blasphemous: Martyrs' Edition
games.summary: The Martyr’s Limited Edition includes the complete Blasphemous game with all expansions, along with a visual compendium featuring iconic artwork, a printed manual, an exclusive art print, a personal letter from the development team, and a digital code to download the full soundtrack.

games.name: Bobo and the Chest of Nightmares
games.summary: Jump, glide, and outsmart traps in this spooky 3D platformer! Smash obstacles, solve puzzles, and fend off evil spirits to defeat The Dream Master. Collect hidden treasures and restore joy to a world shrouded in darkness!

games.name: Goodboy Galaxy
games.summary:
With his home world on the brink of ecological collapse, Maxwell bravely hopped into his experimental ship in dogged pursuit of a solution.

Beyond the point of no return, holding out forlorn hope, he finds himself stranded - thousands of lightyears from home, at the edge of a hostile galaxy.

Help Maxwell explore unfamiliar worlds, make strange new friends and contend with mysterious forces.

Goodboy Galaxy is a game in development for Game Boy Advance, PC and Nintendo Switch. It's an exploration focused platform game similar to Metroid or Cave Story.

games.name: Pinballoid Crush
games.summary: In Pinballoid Crush, classic pinball evolves into an arcade experience with adventure and strategy elements.

games.name: The Cat in the Hat: Rainy Day Mayhem
games.summary:
Everyone from the mischievous Dr. Seuss classic is here. Become smart and steady Sally, energetic wild card Johnny, cause double the trouble as Thing 1 & Thing 2 or be cheerful Little Cat A. And of course, the chaos conductor, The Cat in the Hat and anxiously wise Fish will be there to help, on this zany ride.

Play solo or go against your friends, choosing from two trick-filled game modes. Fancy a game of chase? Then ‘Find the Cat’ will have you turning the house upside down looking for The Cat in the Hat. Or maybe you prefer getting into chaotic challenges? See how quickly you can capture penguins, decorate a cake, and who knows what else in the 18 minigames you can choose from.

But the fun doesn’t stop there, just like The Cat’s hat, it’ll be full of tricks. With varying difficulty levels, long challenges and short, there’s something for everyone.

Get ready for your house to be filled with giggles, groans, and glorious mayhem.

games.name: BloodRayne: Definitive Collection
games.summary:
The BloodRayne: Definitive Edition unites all three iconic entries in the series in one complete, enhanced collection, bringing the legendary dhampir back with updated visuals and modern improvements.

Become Rayne, a half-human, half-vampire agent working for the Brimstone Society, as she hunts supernatural threats across a dark and violent world. From battling occult forces tied to the Third Reich to confronting her own vampiric bloodline, Rayne’s journey spans brutal conflicts, relentless enemies, and deeply personal vendettas.

This collection includes the original BloodRayne, BloodRayne 2, and BloodRayne: Betrayal - Fresh Bites, combining fast-paced third-person action with stylish 2D hack-and-slash gameplay. Face hordes of soldiers, grotesque creatures, and powerful bosses using Rayne’s acrobatic combat skills, brutal melee attacks, and vampiric abilities.

games.name: Fuga: Melodies of Steel 1 / 2 / 3
games.summary:
Introducing the Trilogy Box, a set of three packaged versions of the "Senjou no Fuga" series and luxurious goods!

The long-awaited package version of the trilogy of the dramatic simulation RPG "Fuga of the Battlefield" series with the themes of war, revenge, and beasts is now available!

The Nintendo Switch package, Taranis Metal Figure, art book, and soundtrack will be delivered in a special box.

games.name: Neverway
games.summary:
After Fiona quits her job, she starts over on a farm and becomes the immortal herald of a dead god. 

Keep your life from falling apart while searching for Neverway, a nightmare reality that is slowly leaking into yours.

Neverway features a top-down, fast-paced combat with an emphasis on player expression. Craft items to customize your playstyle, and unlock combat abilities through your friendship bonds.

Farm and craft items, prepare meals, or just decorate your homestead. Time progresses in three blocks, and you choose when to advance: morning, afternoon, and evening. One day at a time.

games.name: Tarot Tokens
games.summary: Is it Impossible OR is it I'm-Possible? Every Split Second of the game matters..! Get ready for a highly reflexive game play that will knock you of your feet. Try it out yourself and take this impossible challenge to set a record to others. This is an incredible running action over 3D obstacles on your path. The obstacles come in simple shape, where you need to jump, dunk or just pass through these shapes. Unlimited action awaits you..! Take up the challenge and beat the records. Caution: Play this game in an isolated area away from distraction. This game need atmost concentration to avoid the obstacles.

games.name: Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters Melee Remastered
games.summary:
The ultimate kaiju arena brawler is back, completely remastered. From Atari and original developer, Pipeworks, Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters Melee Remastered updates the 2002 fighter with enhanced visuals and quality of life improvements. 

Choose your monster and battle it out with a range of brutal attacks through 8 locations, each with day and night variations. Battle through real-world cities, Monster Island, and the alien Mothership. Face off against your friends in local co-op or new online multiplayer.

Master your skills in cinematic kaiju vs. kaiju battles through familiar cities. Every monster has a distinctive moveset that makes each brawl unique, from vicious melee attacks to ranged energy blasts to special Rage Mode strikes. Tired of throwing punches? Why not throw a skyscraper, instead? The arenas are not just passive locations, and instead allow you to use the environment strategically in combat and even weaponize buildings and other landmarks.

games.name: Let's Sing 2027
games.summary:
Grab the mic - or your smartphone - and get ready to shine! The karaoke game Let's Sing 2027 transforms any occasion into a musical celebration with a brand-new playlist of chart-toppers and classics. Sing solo for high scores or team up with friends and family for unforgettable parties and performances.

Featuring songs with their original music videos, adjustable vocal guide settings, and easy-to-use smartphone and mic support, Let's Sing 2027 makes singing accessible, fun, and endlessly replayable. 

Whether you're hosting a party or chasing your best score, it's your turn to take center stage with the ultimate karaoke game!

games.name: Eternal Palace Sakura
games.summary: Sharpen your blades and step into the Eternal Palace Sakura, a dream labyrinth haunted by restless yokai. Battle through ever-shifting realms in this anime-inspired 3D action roguelite, mastering fluid combat and exploring endless floors of the palace!

games.name: K-POP Rising: Dream to Shine
games.summary: In K-POP Rising: Dream to Shine, players immerse themselves in the demanding and fascinating world of modern music. Accompanied by their best friend Nova, they will need to commit 100 percent to the race for stardom: from intensive training sessions in the studio to the ultimate recognition on the most prestigious stages, the title offers a complete experience combining a sense of rhythm, deep customization, and community management in the era of social media.

games.name: Kingdom of Night
games.summary:
One night, in 1987, in the small town of Miami, Arizona, a satanic cult unwittingly summons the ancient evil, Baphomet, catapulting the town into chaos. John, awoken by the kidnapping of his neighbor, sets out into the night to fight back against the demonic invasion and rescue his friends before it's too late...

Take control of John as his adventure leads him through an hour-by-hour experience of what could be everyone's last night on Earth. As John, you will encounter unearthly evils, Demon lords, afflicted townsfolk, high school bullies, and a torrent of engaging, serial-like side stories - all nested in a larger-than-life fantasy that brings the ultimate evil to a neighborhood near you.

Choose your class, customize your abilities, and battle nightmarish creatures as you collect unique gear in order to infiltrate the massive lairs of Demon lords that have taken over the town.

games.name: MANIC MINER
games.summary:
Experience a milestone in video game history in a completely reimagined version! 

Authorized by original developer Matthew Smith, this reboot of the 1983 classic combines the distinctive and challenging gameplay of MANIC MINER with modern graphics, improved controls, newly arranged music, and extensive historical bonus content.

Step back into the role of miner Willy and take on 20 legendary levels filled with deadly creatures, clever jumps, and tricky obstacles. Collect all the items before your oxygen runs out and master one of the most challenging platformers of all time.

games.name: Next of Kin: Epiphany
games.summary:
Do you have what it takes to catch "The Epiphany Killer"?

Step into the world of "Next of Kin: Epiphany," where you become private detective Dennis Monroe, a relentless investigator driven to catch the infamous "Epiphany Killer," a shadowy figure who has haunted the city for over twenty years. Every clue draws you closer to the truth, but danger lurks behind every revelation.

In the thrilling conclusion to the "Next of Kin" trilogy, you'll explore atmospheric locations, interrogate suspects with the powerful new "Expose" system, and unravel the chilling truth behind the notorious "Epiphany Killer".

games.name: Hasbro Games Junior Collection
games.summary:
Get ready for a big, colourful game night full of laughs, surprises, and “just one more turn!” moments! This collection brings 3 classic junior board games to life in one exciting video game made for kids and families.

Race around the board in Monopoly Jr., where every dice roll can help you grab cool places, collect money, and become the last player standing. Put on your detective hat in Cluedo Jr. as you search for clues, cross off suspects, and solve the case before anyone else! Then jump into The Game of Life Jr., spin the spinner, drive your car along the path, and collect stars as you go.

Play on your own or in local multiplayer for up to 4 players on one console. Create your own adorable avatar and make it truly yours with fun customization options and unlock new looks and cosmetic rewards just by playing matches.

Easy to learn and packed with exciting moments every round, it’s perfect for family game nights, friendly competition, and big smiles from start to finish!

games.name: Pretty Girls Game Collection V
games.summary:
The latest entry in the popular compilation series brings together four fan-favourite Pretty Girls titles in one value-packed retail release, offering players a diverse selection of puzzle and casual gameplay experiences paired with the charming anime-style presentation that fans have come to expect from the franchise.

Each of the four games has been enhanced with exclusive naughty content, that fans of the series have become accustomed to, amounting to a wealth of new images direct from the Japanese creators that would otherwise not have been possible to release on console even in their home country, making this essential and definitive.

games.name: MARVEL Cosmic Invasion: The Siege of Castle Doom
Super Monkey Ball Triple Pack

games.name: Warhammer Survivors
games.summary:
Warhammer Survivors is a fast-paced roguelite survivors' game, pitting a host of iconic Warhammer characters against endless hordes of enemies from multiple Warhammer factions. 

Developed by Auroch Digital (Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun) in partnership with Warhammer and poncle (Vampire Survivors), discover the universes of Warhammer 40,000 and Warhammer: Age of Sigmar in all its pixel glory in this new surviv-a-ton.

games.name: Prinny Party: Going Overboard!
games.summary: Get your friends together for Prinny Party: Going Overboard! In this party game, you’ll traverse the board as you take down demons, earn experience, and buy new equipment—all to make sure you’re strong enough to defeat the Supreme Overboard!

games.name: BALL x PIT: Risen Ballbylon
games.summary:
You’re used to the lift descending into the depths of the pit – but now it’s going up. In this massive expansion for smash hit ball-bouncing roguelite BALL x PIT, rise above the abyss to reach Risen Ballbylon, which floats high in the sky above. Each level is a layer of the former city, where the population has been warped by the effects of the meteor.

Risen Ballbylon is the biggest and most transformative expansion for BALL x PIT yet, adding a wealth of new characters, balls, passives, enemies, bosses, buildings, and levels, dramatically expanding the possibilities of a run and introducing fresh new gameplay mechanics to test even the most hardened veterans of the pit. Will you rise to the challenge?

games.name: Moomin: Midsummer Madness
games.summary:
Moomin: Midsummer Madness is a delightfully playful point-and-click adventure inspired by Tove Jansson’s cherished Nordic fantasy novel, Moominsummer Madness. 

Play as Moomintroll and Little My as they explore a curious old theatre caught in a great flood. The journey will be filled with endearing encounters, familiar faces, and a touch of mischief.

games.name: Expelled from Paradise: The Stellar Angel
games.summary:
A brand-new sequel depicting the aftermath of the theatrical anime Expelled from Paradise. The story of Angela and Dingo begins to move once more. 

This is a full-scale visual novel that weaves a grand science-fiction vision through evocative text and immersive direction.

games.name: Marupoyo: The Round Chick's Adventure
games.summary: A tilt-based platformer game for everyone. Players control Marupoyo’s momentum as he rolls through 120 vibrant levels, avoiding obstacles, exploring, and rescuing his lost siblings.

games.name: Bulbo's Belief System
games.summary:
Bulbo's Belief System is a puzzle-platformer where knowledge is both a tool and an obstacle. Bulbo believes everything he's told - learning allows him to see, move, and interact, but forgetting is just as important.

Erase walls from existence, ignore gravity to walk across gaps, and manage conflicting beliefs to solve mind-bending challenges. Experiment with what Bulbo knows (or doesn't) to navigate a world where perception shapes reality.

Can you control what Bulbo learns and unlearns to reach the goal?

games.name: Danger Mouse
games.summary:
Baron Greenback has fallen on hard times...

Feeling nostalgic for the “bad old days,” Greenback launches his boldest evil plan yet, forcing Danger Mouse and Penfold to re-live all their epic encounters. 

Will Greenback get a second chance at victory, or is this the final game over?

games.name: Disney Dreamlight Valley: The Keepsake Sea
games.summary:
Get ready to dive into an entirely new adventure as you become a magical Merfolk and embark on a sweeping journey across the sea to reach a faraway kingdom, where strange echoes of its past await. Along the way, you’ll meet some unforgettable new friends, including Milo Thatch, Captain Jack Sparrow, and Megara, as you uncover the mysteries waiting beyond the waves.

The Keepsake Sea will introduce brand-new Biomes to explore, mysterious underwater areas to uncover, and new spaces to fully customize. From exploring what lies beneath the surface to discovering the secrets of this faraway kingdom, there’s plenty of adventure waiting for you!

games.name: Hillthorn
games.summary: Do you love the Valentin's Day and video slots? Download this great Valentine's theme slots machine game for FREE! Happy spinning and good luck! Great graphics for the New iPad and iPad4's Retina display! This game is for those 21 or older for entertainment only.

games.name: Winx Club: Moonlight Quest
games.summary: Hieroglyph was named to honour Egypt as the origin of written language. The game is a six sided variation of a familiar word game, extended for memorising and expanding vocabulary. Each puzzle contains a list of words to locate, arranged in three different ways: in rows, zig-zags and in clusters. Some puzzles may be useful, others humourous, hopefully you will find all of some interest. Over the course of the next year from time to time new puzzles will be made available.

games.name: Aeterna Lucis
games.summary:
Aeterna Lucis is a Metroidvania focused on fast-paced combat, exploration, and an engaging story. The sequel to Aeterna Noctis follows the steps of its predecessor including a brand new protagonist and a large interconnected world! 

After the events of the first game, the Queen of Light must stop the destruction of the very existence by challenging the Supreme God Chaos while seeking the location of their old nemesis.

games.name: STEP THEATER
games.summary:
An uplifting rhythm game where your steps bring stories to life.

Step Theater is a music-and-rhythm game where you step to the beat to bring each “film” to life.

With every step, the story begins to unfold, the stage comes alive with color, and each film takes shape. As you progress, Step Theater gradually regains its buzz, and new films begin their run.

Each film offers a unique world and style, from tales of school life to side-scrolling-game-inspired stages. The music, backgrounds, characters, and actions all change from stage to stage, keeping every play session fresh.

Adorable characters in motion, catchy original songs, and stories brought to life by your own steps.

With your steps, make the theatre light and lively again.
